name: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver
description: A half-hour satirical look at the week in news, politics and current events.

videos.title: General Keith Alexander Extended Interview
videos.overview: John Oliver interviews General Keith Alexander, former head of the NSA. General Alexander discusses Edward Snowden and helps John rebrand a national security organization.

videos.title: President Obama Meets a Robot: Web Exclusive
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses President Barack Obama's trip to Japan where he met a "scary" robot.

videos.title: Simon Ostrovsky Interview
videos.overview:
John Oliver interviews Vice news journalist Simon Ostrovsky who was held captive in Ukraine.

This is still a comedy show, we promise.

videos.title: Letter of the Week: POM Wonderful
videos.overview: In response to our segment in our premiere on food labeling, POM Wonderful sent us a refrigerator full of juice and an elegantly worded letter implying what we can do with it.

videos.title: Fareed Zakaria Interview Pt. 2
videos.overview: John Oliver and Fareed Zakaria further discuss the victory of Narendra Modi in India's recent election.

videos.title: Last Week's News... We Think
videos.overview: John Oliver delivers last week's news, predicted two weeks ago.  You get it. Just watch.

videos.title: #MutuallyAssuredHumiliation
videos.overview: With this web exclusive video, the Last Week Tonight staff would like to thank some of the heroes and pioneers who helped make the internet a safer place through #MutuallyAssuredHumiliation.

videos.title: Stephen Hawking Extended Interview
videos.overview: John Oliver talks to Stephen Hawking in the first installment of Last Week Tonight's new "People Who Think Good" series. They cover such topics as parallel universes, artificial intelligence, and Charlize Theron.

videos.title: Pepe Julian Onziema Interview Pt. II
videos.overview: John Oliver talks in depth with Ugandan LGBTI rights activist Pepe Julian Onziema about the oppressive anti-gay legislation in Uganda as well as the western involvement in inspiring those laws.

videos.title: Fireworks
videos.overview: With Last Week Tonight on hiatus, John Oliver takes to the internet to cover the most important story of the past week: Fireworks.

videos.title: #WeGotThoseGeckos
videos.overview: Last week on Last Week Tonight, John Oliver told us to tell Vladimir Putin to #GoGetThoseGeckos. This week, there's some good news...#WeGotThoseGeckos.

videos.title: John Oliver Literally Destroys Piñatas
videos.overview: Watch John Oliver deliver an epic takedown of piñatas.

videos.title: Fan Mail Vol. 1
videos.overview: John Oliver reads fan mail, but because no one sends mail anymore, it’s all from YouTube comments.

videos.title: Cookie Monster's Ideas
videos.overview: Cookie Monster has a few ideas to share with John Oliver. John just wants you to watch their special news report on words.

videos.title: Roger Goodell
videos.overview: Roger Goodell spoke about the NFL’s recent controversies. And he spoke badly. Boo this man.

videos.title: Pumpkin Spice
videos.overview:
Pumpkin spice. Why?

John Oliver investigates. Well, he doesn't really investigate. He says things about it, though!

videos.title: Real Animals, Fake Paws Footage
videos.overview: We have provided this footage for you to do your own Supreme Court reenactments. Please feel free to use it, post your videos, and tag them #RealAnimalsFakePaws so we can find them.

videos.title: 1,000,000 YouTube Subscribers
videos.overview: We have accumulated 1,000,000 YouTube subscribers. We’re not really sure what that means!

videos.title: Turkey Pardoning
videos.overview: Turkey pardoning is a weird tradition. They're basically all guilty... of being delicious.

videos.title: New Year's Eve
videos.overview: New Year's Eve is the worst. John Oliver has some great excuses for getting out of it.

videos.title: Fifty Shades #NotMyChristian Apology
videos.overview: John Oliver apologizes to Jamie Dornan for perpetuating the #NotMyChristian hashtag...sort of.

videos.title: April Fools' Day
videos.overview: April Fools’ Day is awful. Please stand with John Oliver and take the Last Week Tonight No-Prank Pledge.

videos.title: Edward Snowden on Passwords
videos.overview: John Oliver and Edward Snowden talk password security.

videos.title: Lost Graphics
videos.overview: John Oliver shows off some of his favorite graphics that never made it onto the show.

videos.title: The Mittens of Disapproval Are On
videos.overview: John responds to former FIFA Vice President Jack Warner’s wild “The Gloves Are Off” paid political program by buying his own airtime on Trinidad television.

videos.title: And Now - People Prematurely Declaring The End of Obamacare
videos.overview: Five years of people prematurely declaring the end of Obamacare. (This is a web-exclusive video.)

videos.title: Shallow Dives
videos.overview: Instead of covering 1 topic in 15 minutes, John Oliver covers 15 topics in 1 minute.

videos.title: History Lies
videos.overview: John Oliver shares some of his favorite completely made-up history facts.

videos.title: Back To School
videos.overview: John Oliver gives students a crash course in everything they will learn — or not learn — in school this year.

videos.title: Facebook Privacy Hoax Debunked
videos.overview: John Oliver explains that the Facebook privacy protection messages are a hoax and tells you how to actually protect your personal information.

videos.title: Regifting
videos.overview: You will receive at least one horrible gift this month. John Oliver has some tips for getting rid of it.

videos.title: Revised Resolutions
videos.overview: John Oliver helps you revise the New Year’s resolutions you’ve already failed to keep.

videos.title: Lost Graphics Vol. 2
videos.overview: John Oliver shares more of his favorite graphics that never made it on the show.

videos.title: Conspiracies
videos.overview: John Oliver delves into the world of conspiracies and the imagination required to create them. He attempts to wake up the sheeple by showing how Cadbury's Crème Egg is funding the Illuminati.

videos.title: Cicadas
videos.overview: A mass of cicadas will soon emerge after 17 years in the ground so John Oliver attempts to fill them in on what they have missed since 1999.

videos.title: How is this Not a Thing?
videos.overview: John Oliver looks at some things that don't exist, but definitely should.

videos.title: Independence Day
videos.overview: To celebrate the anniversary of America’s Independence John Oliver reminds us what they lost in the process.

videos.title: Fan Mail Vol. 2
videos.overview: John Oliver reads some fan mail, once again they all come from YouTube comments.

videos.title: Endorsements
videos.overview: John Oliver makes some official political endorsements.

videos.title: Johnny Strong
videos.overview: Fed up with the constant stream of superhero movies, John Oliver pitches an original idea for a summer blockbuster based on the adventures of Johnny Strong.

videos.title: Labor Day
videos.overview: Intrigued by the rule against wearing white after Labor Day, John Oliver suggests some other holiday rules to live by.

videos.title: Birds
videos.overview: John Oliver isn’t fond of birds. So as they begin their migration for winter he gives them a piece of his mind.

videos.title: Net Neutrality Update
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the recent flood of comments posted on the FCC's website.

videos.title: Lost Graphics Vol. 3
videos.overview: John Oliver shares another collection of his favorite graphics that never made it onto the show.

videos.title: Retractions
videos.overview: John Oliver sets the record straight about some dubious claims he’s made in the past.

videos.title: SantaCon
videos.overview: The holiday season brings with it a host of annual traditions. John Oliver discusses one of the worst.

videos.title: Push Notifications
videos.overview: John Oliver explains what type of news should – and shouldn’t – warrant a push notification.

videos.title: Pringles Update
videos.overview: With the help of viewers at home, John tries to get to the bottom of an important mystery.

videos.title: Lost Graphics Vol. 4
videos.overview: John Oliver shares some of his favorite graphics that never made it to air.

videos.title: Cereal
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why we need a fun new cereal, and makes a proposition for Cheerios.

videos.title: Octopuses
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why octopuses are cool, great, and yes, called “octopuses”.

videos.title: John Dillermand
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why a Danish children's cartoon resonates with him so much.

videos.title: Masterpiece Gallery Tour
videos.overview: You are cordially invited to attend Last Week Tonight's Masterpiece Gallery Tour. Visit lwtgallery.com or johnoliverhasyourraterotica.com for details.

videos.title: Local Car Commercials Update
videos.overview: John Oliver reveals the brave local car dealership that agreed to produce Last Week Tonight’s commercial script, sight unseen.

videos.title: Snack Video Games
videos.overview: John Oliver explores the lost world of snack-sponsored video games, and pitches some ideas to today’s snack brands.

videos.title: Da Vinci Code
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses The Da Vinci Code: the book, the film, and, for some reason, the cultural phenomenon.

videos.title: Air Bud
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses rules, moral intention, and 1997's Air Bud.

videos.title: Rocks
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses Kandiss Taylor, a prominent loser in the race for governor of Georgia, and fierce anti-rock activist.

videos.title: Beach Dolls
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses a surplus of dolls which have been mysteriously washing up on the beach in Texas, and, crucially, how they can be destroyed.

videos.title: AI Images
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the new trend of AI-generated images based on text prompts, and, of course, what it all has to do with cabbage.

videos.title: Trash
videos.overview: John Oliver explores trash and takes care of some unfinished business in the Ohio of Sweden.

videos.title: Last Squeak Tonight Presents: A History of Chuck E. Cheese
videos.overview: In lieu of Homeowners Association, the Last Week Tonight team has prepared an alternative story made specifically for people under 35; one that focuses on a different crumbling American institution that you and your age cohorts might find deeply nostalgic: Chuck E. Cheese.

videos.title: Mike Lindell & MyStore
videos.overview: John Oliver talks about Mike Lindell, the online marketplace that is his mesmerizingly bizarre version of Amazon dot com, and why you shouldn’t argue with the wind.

videos.title: Air Bud (2)
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the Air Bud franchise. Again. For even longer than he did last time. And for good reason, thank you very much!

videos.title: Air Bud (3)
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the Air Bud franchise for the third time, including some surprising revelations about both the financing and production schedule for the newest Air Bud film.

videos.title: POM Wonderful v. Coca-Cola
videos.overview: John talks about the Indian election, Pom Wonderful and talks with the former NSA Director General Keith Alexander.

videos.title: Capital Punishment
videos.overview: John talks about the recent issues of the death penalty, François Hollande and the rising issues happening in Brunei.

videos.title: Climate Change Denial
videos.overview: John talks about Eurovision, Ukraine and Russia's relations and interviews Bill Nye about Climate Change.

videos.title: The Right to Be Forgotten
videos.overview: John talks about the product recall going on at General Motors, the EU Court of Justice "Right to be Forgotten" ruling and updates us on how the Indian election is going with help from Fareed Zakaria.

videos.title: Net Neutrality
videos.overview: John talks about the rise of the far-right political parties in Europe, the Ukrainian election, Afghanistan, Net Neutrality, Australia's hard-line right-wing Prime Minister Tony Abbott and the 2014 Scripps National Spelling Bee.

videos.title: FIFA and the World Cup
videos.overview: John talks about California Chrome and the Belmont Stakes, FIFA and the 2014 World Cup, and Syrian President Bashar al-Assad.

videos.title: Immigration Reform
videos.overview: John talks about US Immigration and interviews Professor Stephen Hawking.

videos.title: Dr. Oz
videos.overview: John talks about Iraq, Antarctica tourism and Dr. Oz's "Miracle Drug".

videos.title: Burwell v. Hobby Lobby
videos.overview: John Oliver sheds light on recent Supreme Court cases and discusses gay rights in Uganda with activist Pepe Julian Onziema.

videos.title: Income and Wealth Inequality
videos.overview: John talks about modern American income inequality, Warren G. Harding's love letters and President Obama's "Day In The Life" tour.

videos.title: Incarceration in the United States
videos.overview: John talks about the Gaza crisis, the decay of American prisons and the gambling addiction problem in Singapore.

videos.title: Nuclear Weapons and the United States
videos.overview: John talks about human rights violations in the Middle East, nuclear disarmament and Russia's science satellite that lost communication.

videos.title: Native Advertising
videos.overview: John talks about Uganda's anti-gay laws, the CIA's recent report on their use of torture, the New York Port Authority, Argentina's default on debt and native advertising.

videos.title: Payday Loans
videos.overview: John talks about the return of US military actions in Iraq, replacing all passwords due to a global security breach and the terrible practices of the Payday Loan industry.

videos.title: Shooting of Michael Brown and Police Militarization
videos.overview: Focuses on the shooting of Michael Brown and police militarization in Ferguson, MO. John also discusses the topic of equal pay for equal work.

videos.title: Student Debt
videos.overview: John talks about ISIS and student loan debt. Musical group A Great Big World make a special appearance.

videos.title: Scottish Independence Referendum
videos.overview: John talks about the NFL's decision on Ray Rice's contract, the international response to ISIS, Scotland's separation from the United Kingdom and Twitter hashtags that are being misused by corporations.

videos.title: United States Embargo Against Cuba, Miss America 2015
videos.overview:
John covers the results of the Scottish referendum that took place the week before and explains why the policy of United States having embargo against Cuba doesn't make sense .

The main story focuses on the Miss America pageant and their scholarships to women. John explains how outdated and absurd the requirements for the contestants are and to illustrate these problems, stages his own pageant with the help of a guest star - Kathy Griffin.

videos.title: Drones
videos.overview: John discusses U.S. military drones and the Kansas state budget shortfall. Also, Narendra Modi, the Prime Minster of India visited New York and did some classic New York things.

videos.title: Civil Forfeiture
videos.overview: Main story: how desperate the American law enforcement is to make money out of everyone by using the process called the "civil asset forfeiture," and how it would make for a weird episode of "Law and Order." Plus, John wants to host the 2022 Winter Olympics and how is Columbus Day still a thing.

videos.title: Military Translators
videos.overview: Translators who have aided the U.S. Military in Afghanistan and Iraq are in great danger in their home countries, but red tape is making it impossible for many of them to leave. John Oliver interviews FNU Mohammad, one translator who made it out. Plus, since cameras aren’t allowed in the Supreme Court discussions, most coverage of the important cases looks like garbage. John fixes that problem with real animals and fake paws.

videos.title: Sugar
videos.overview: John Oliver talks about a Russian submarine in Sweden, ebola in New York, added sugar in food, Rob Ford's brother and interviews Jane Goodall.

videos.title: State Legislatures and ALEC
videos.overview: While midterm coverage is largely focused on the parts of Congress that do very little, vital (and bizarre) midterm elections are going unexamined. State legislators pass a lot of bills, and some of that efficiency is thanks to a group called ALEC that writes legislation for them. It’s as shady as it sounds!

videos.title: The Lottery
videos.overview:
The Lottery: State lotteries claim to be good for education and the general wellbeing of citizens. But are they? (Spoiler alert: No.)

Also, there is a cannon that shoots salmon over dams. It’s awesome. Check it out.

videos.title: Marketing to Doctors
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the growing issues of pharmaceutical companies marketing directly to and through doctors. Also, since RadioShack has filed for bankruptcy, John has created a farewell message for them. Plus, the online sessions by Ecuadorian President Rafael Correa to address the public aren't going too well.

videos.title: Tobacco
videos.overview: Thanks to tobacco industry regulations and marketing restrictions in the U.S., smoking rates have dropped dramatically. John Oliver explains how tobacco companies are keeping their business strong overseas and how Phillip Morris International in particular is employing some unethical legal practices while suing some of the world's poorest countries. Plus, we've noticed that the Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue still exists but can’t quite figure out why.

videos.title: Elected Judges
videos.overview:
The vast majority of US judges are elected, forcing many judges to pander to the electorate and accept campaign money in order to keep their jobs. This seems slightly troubling... 

The UK's Labour Party has painted a campaign van pink in an attempt to attract women voters. We are glad they didn't keep going with that strategy.

videos.title: Infrastructure
videos.overview: America's crumbling infrastructure: It's not a sexy problem, but it is a scary one.

videos.title: U.S. Territories
videos.overview: A set of Supreme Court decisions made over 100 years ago has left U.S. territories without meaningful representation. That’s weird, right? Plus, daylight saving time doesn’t actually benefit anyone. Strangely, it’s still a thing!

videos.title: The NCAA
videos.overview: The NCAA doesn’t pay athletes because they consider them amateurs. The NCAA considers them amateurs because they don’t get paid.

videos.title: Municipal Violations
videos.overview: If you have money, committing a municipal violation may pose you a minor inconvenience. If you don’t, it can ruin your life. Also, the New Hampshire legislature refused to make the red-tailed hawk the official raptor of their state... so Last Week Tonight made it the official raptor of the show.

videos.title: Government Surveillance
videos.overview: There are very few government checks on what America’s sweeping surveillance programs are capable of doing. John Oliver sits down with Edward Snowden to discuss the NSA, the balance between privacy and security, and dick-pics.

videos.title: The IRS
videos.overview: Nobody likes the IRS. But recent budget and staff cuts have made it increasingly difficult for the department to do its very important job. Don’t take our word for it. Ask Michael Bolton.

videos.title: Patents
videos.overview: For inventors, patents are an essential protection against theft. But when patent trolls abuse the system by stockpiling patents and threatening lawsuits, businesses are forced to shell out tons of money. Also, CNN produced an actual doomsday video to broadcast when the world is ending and it’s incredibly dull. We've enlisted Martin Sheen to help make humanity’s final moments happier!

videos.title: Fashion
videos.overview: John explores the concept of changing and cheap fashion and some of the ugliest truths of the manufacturing process.

videos.title: Standardized Testing
videos.overview: American students face a ridiculous amount of testing. John Oliver explains how standardized tests impact school funding, the achievement gap and how often the kids are expected to throw up while taking one.

videos.title: Paid Family Leave
videos.overview: Many American companies do not offer paid leave after the birth of a child, which means they probably shouldn’t run sappy Mother’s Day ads. Also, the Japanese have some unhealthy obsession with mascots and John proposes to adopt some of that culture in the U.S. government agencies as well.

videos.title: Chickens
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how chicken farming can be unfair, punishing, and inhumane. And not just for the chickens!

videos.title: FIFA II
videos.overview: After the arrests of numerous top officials, John Oliver decided to give an update on the state of FIFA. Also, Thailand's ignorance about the world's history involving Hitler might require some re-education.

videos.title: Bail
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why America’s bail system is better for the reality TV industry than it is for the justice system.

videos.title: Torture
videos.overview: The US Senate Torture Report revealed horrifying details of America's interrogation program. Helen Mirren will fill you in. Plus, information about the 2015 European Games and the Canadian Senate expenses scandal.

videos.title: The Internet
videos.overview: Online harassment is a major problem, but it’s rarely prosecuted. If only we’d been warned about this in the early days of the internet.

videos.title: Transgender Rights
videos.overview: This week’s gay rights victory was historic, but the transgender community still faces staggering challenges. John Oliver focuses on the “T” in “LGBT."

videos.title: Stadiums
videos.overview: Cities spend massive amounts of public money on privately-owned stadiums. Cities issue tax-exempt municipal bonds that — wait, don’t fall asleep!

videos.title: Food Waste
videos.overview: Producers, sellers, and consumers waste tons of food. John Oliver discusses the shocking amount of food we don’t eat.

videos.title: Mandatory Minimum Sentencing Laws
videos.overview: Mandatory minimums require fixed prison sentences for certain crimes. John Oliver explains why we treat some turkeys better than most low-level offenders.

videos.title: District of Columbia
videos.overview: Washington DC experiences taxation without representation. It's also missing from rhyming state songs. John Oliver and a group of singing children fix one of these problems. Plus, a sex scandal involving the Chairman of the British House of Lords.

videos.title: Sex Education
videos.overview: Sex education varies widely between school districts, leaving many teens without comprehensive information. We made a video that covers what some schools are too embarrassed to teach.

videos.title: Church
videos.overview: John discusses predatory churches and televangelism, and how the U.S. tax law allows them to get away with almost anything. Plus, the raising of the American flag in Cuba, the redesign of New Zealand's flag, and President Harding's illegitimate child.

videos.title: LGBT Discrimination
videos.overview: This year’s gay marriage ruling was a milestone, but LGBT discrimination is still surprisingly legal. John Oliver explains why we need a federal anti-discrimination law. Plus, the rising tensions on the border between North and South Korea, and why Vladimir Putin has started a war on food.

videos.title: Public Defenders
videos.overview: The Miranda warning includes the right to a public defender. It doesn’t include the fact that public defenders are highly overworked and grossly underpaid. Plus, a Michigan state legislature scandal, Guatemala's unusual election, and the longevity of Queen Elizabeth II.

videos.title: Migrants and Refugees
videos.overview: Millions of migrants seeking asylum in Europe face hostility, racism, and red tape. John Oliver does one admittedly tiny thing for one of them. Plus Pope's visit to the U.S., the unsavory practices of Volkswagen car manufacturer, and some shocking allegations about the activities of former British PM David Cameron.

videos.title: Mental Health
videos.overview: John discusses Russia's involvement in Syria, the U.N. General Assembly, and the problems with the national system for treating mental illness. Plus, why creating a Yelp-like app for rating other people seems like a bad idea.

videos.title: North Dakota
videos.overview: North Dakota is known for being polite, but perhaps they’ve been a little too hospitable to oil companies. Plus, the mess atop of FIFA's leadership and the connection between Toyota and ISIS.

videos.title: Canada
videos.overview: Canada is about to have a major election. John Oliver enlists Mike Myers, a beaver, and a moose to give voters some advice. Plus, the unpopularity of the Mexican president Enrique Peña Nieto and the habit of American politicians to misquote historical figures.

videos.title: Medicaid Gap
videos.overview: John Oliver looks at the upcoming local state elections, the results of which could affect the lives of millions of Americans that are looking for Medicaid assistance. Plus, the 'peace talks' held in Vienna, Austria concerning the war in Syria gather nearly 20 countries, but not a single representative from Syria itself. And how Kenny G could help de-escalate the tension between China and its neighbors in South China Sea.

videos.title: Prisoner Re-entry
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses problems that prisoners face when re-entering the society after they're released from prison. A quick interview with Bilal Chatman shines a light on one such case. Plus, a law proposed in the United Kingdom advocates for a mass surveillance of citizens' online activities, how Department of Defense is paying huge sums of money to professional sports teams to honor veterans during their events, and Washington Redskins file a lawsuit to defend their poorly chosen trademark name by naming other terrible examples.

videos.title: Daily Fantasy Sports
videos.overview: John talks about the recent Paris attacks, China's Singles Day, the Koh-i-Noor diamond and Daily Fantasy Sports.

videos.title: Refugees & Pennies
videos.overview: John reflects on the aftermath of Paris attacks and how it affects refugees worldwide. Plus, he questions the usefulness of the U.S. penny, since minting the coins costs more than they're actually worth.

videos.title: Voting
videos.overview: John talks about the late Antonin Scalia's love of the Letter of the Law, Chipotle's food safety problems, how Voter IDs laws should be applied to those who write them, and New Zealand's economic development minister Steven Joyce.

videos.title: Abortion Laws
videos.overview: John talks about the South Carolina Republican primary, the Supreme Court vacancy and abortion, which theoretically is legal in the U.S., but some states make it practically inaccessible. Plus, how is Hollywood whitewashing still a thing?

videos.title: Donald Trump
videos.overview: John talks about the Egyptian president and economic crisis, the Guantanamo Bay shutdown and Donald Trump.

videos.title: Special Districts
videos.overview: Special districts spend more public money than all city governments combined. That's odd considering most of us don't know they exist.

videos.title: Encryption
videos.overview: Strong encryption poses problems for law enforcement, is weakening it worth the risks it presents? It's…complicated.

videos.title: Border Wall
videos.overview: Donald Drumpf wants to build a wall on the U.S.-Mexico border. Is his plan feasible?

videos.title: Congressional Fundraising
videos.overview: Lawmakers have to raise money to keep their jobs, but a surprising amount of their job now consists of raising money. John Oliver sits down with Congressman Steve Israel to discuss the costs of political spending.

videos.title: Credit Reports
videos.overview: Credit reports play a surprisingly large role in our lives, but even more surprising is how often they contain critical mistakes. John Oliver helps credit agencies see why this is a problem.

videos.title: Lead
videos.overview: Lead poisoning is a national problem. If only lawmakers were as concerned as the puppets on Sesame Street.

videos.title: Puerto Rico
videos.overview: Puerto Rico is suffering a massive debt crisis. Lin-Manuel Miranda joins John Oliver to call for relief.

videos.title: Scientific Studies
videos.overview: John Oliver on Sticking to the Facts: Media outlets often report new findings from scientific studies, but how many are true?

John Oliver on 911 Reliability: Things you never want to hear: there are no guarantees when you call 911. Emergency call centers are in desperate need of funding and new technology, so “no guarantees” is the unfortunate reality.

videos.title: Primaries and Caucuses
videos.overview: Last Week Tonight Tackles U.S. Primaries and Caucuses: The United States selection process for presidential nominees is convoluted — to say the least. Nevertheless, John Oliver reminds Americans that the "middle of the game" is the worst possible time to change the rules.

videos.title: Debt Buyers
videos.overview: John Oliver Takes On Debt Buyers: Companies that purchase debt on the cheap will aggressively collect on it. 'Last Week Tonight’ took a hands-on approach to addressing this issue.

videos.title: Retirement Plans
videos.overview: John Oliver Covers Ins and Outs of Retirement Plans: Saving for retirement means navigating a potential minefield of high fees and bad advice - Last Week Tonight is here to help.

videos.title: Brexit
videos.overview: John Oliver on “Brexiting” from the EU: There might be an innate British desire to diss Europe, but Last Week Tonight lays out exactly why it’s a mistake to leave the EU.

videos.title: Doping
videos.overview: John talks about the aftermath of the Brexit vote in the United Kingdom and doping in sports with the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio on the horizon.

videos.title: Republican National Convention
videos.overview: John talks about the disastrous Republican National Convention in Cleveland, where politicians were mostly talking about their feelings equating them to facts. Plus, Hillary Clinton's VP pick, the appointment of Boris Johnson as Britain's Foreign Secretary, the resignation of Roger Ailes from FOX and the unauthorized use of songs in political campaigns.

videos.title: Democratic National Convention
videos.overview: John covers the rocky Democratic National Convention in Philadelphia. Plus, the military coup in Turkey and its aftermath, the voter ID laws targeting the minorities and how are tanning beds still a thing.

videos.title: Journalism
videos.overview: John Oliver has some bad news about the state of the industry that gives us our news. Plus, the coverage of the Opening Ceremony of Rio Olympics.

videos.title: Auto Lending
videos.overview: Auto lenders can steer vulnerable people into crushing debt. Keegan-Michael Key and Bob Balaban help John Oliver show exactly how.

videos.title: Charter Schools
videos.overview: Charter schools are privately run, publicly funded, and irregularly regulated. John Oliver explores why they aren’t at all like pizzerias.

videos.title: Scandals
videos.overview: Taking a walk down memory lane, 'Last Week Tonight' assesses Donald Trump's vs. Hillary Clinton's scandals.

videos.title: Police Accountability
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the systems in place to investigate and hold police officers accountable for misconduct.

videos.title: Guantánamo
videos.overview: John Oliver examines the legal and moral issues surrounding the military prison at Guantánamo Bay.

videos.title: Third Parties
videos.overview: Third party candidates want to be serious contenders, so John Oliver considers them seriously as potential presidents.

videos.title: Opioids
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the extent and root of the nation’s epidemic of opioid addiction.

videos.title: School Segregation
videos.overview: Public schools are increasingly divided by race and class. John Oliver discusses the troubling trend towards school resegregation.

videos.title: Multilevel Marketing
videos.overview: Multilevel marketing companies claim to be legitimate businesses, but some seems awfully pyramid shaped, and that's a problem.

videos.title: President-Elect Trump
videos.overview: The presidential race has been a hell of a ride. ‘Last Week Tonight’ closes out the election and Season 3 with a bang.

videos.title: Trump vs. Truth
videos.overview: Donald Trump spreads a lot of false information thanks to his daily consumption of morning cable news. If only we could sneak some facts into the president’s media diet.

videos.title: Putin
videos.overview: Vladimir Putin is known as a ruthless leader and master manipulator. John Oliver enlists a group of singing dancers to explain that to Donald Trump.

videos.title: Obamacare
videos.overview: Congressional Republicans could soon vote to repeal Obamacare. John Oliver explores why their replacement plans are similar to a thong.

videos.title: Dalai Lama
videos.overview: Tibetan Buddhists have suffered deep persecution by the Chinese government. John Oliver sits down with the Dalai Lama to discuss China, the conditions in Tibet, and horse milk.

videos.title: American Health Care Act
videos.overview: The Republican health care bill could leave many Americans without affordable coverage. Last Week Tonight's catheter cowboy returns to morning cable news to explain that to Donald Trump.

videos.title: Federal Budget
videos.overview: Donald Trump's federal budget plan proposes large funding cuts with largely negative consequences. John Oliver examines the troubling priorities of the new administration.

videos.title: Marijuana
videos.overview: Under federal law, even legal marijuana is illegal. John Oliver explains why conflicting drug laws pose serious problems.

videos.title: Gerrymandering
videos.overview: Lawmakers often reshape voting districts to shift the balance of political power. That's unfair to voters, even those of us with questionable judgment.

videos.title: French Elections
videos.overview: The presidential election in France could determine the political future of Europe. John Oliver visits an excessively French bistro to deliver an urgent message to voters.

videos.title: Ivanka & Jared
videos.overview: Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner hold an incredible amount of political power. That's troubling considering their incredibly small amount of political experience.

videos.title: Net Neutrality II
videos.overview: Equal access to online information is once again under serious threat. John Oliver encourages internet commenters to voice their displeasure to the FCC by visiting www.gofccyourself.com.

videos.title: Dialysis
videos.overview: For-profit dialysis companies often maximize their profits at the expense of their patients. John Oliver explores why a medical clinic is nothing like a Taco Bell.

videos.title: Stupid Watergate
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the shocking magnitude and potential impact of the latest revelations surrounding the Russia investigation.

videos.title: Paris Agreement
videos.overview: Donald Trump plans to withdraw the United States from the Paris agreement on climate change. That's bad news for anyone who happens to live on this planet.

videos.title: Brexit II
videos.overview: In the wake of a divisive election, the UK will begin the process of leaving the European Union. John Oliver and an intergalactic space lord propose a plan.

videos.title: Coal
videos.overview: We’ve heard a lot of talk about coal miners in the last year, but what are the real issues surrounding coal? John Oliver and a giant squirrel look into it.

videos.title: Vaccines
videos.overview: The benefits of vaccines far outweigh the minuscule risks, but some parents still question their safety. John Oliver discusses why some people may still feel uncertainty about childhood vaccinations.

videos.title: Sinclair Broadcast Group
videos.overview: Sinclair Broadcast Group is the largest owner of local TV stations in the country. That's alarming considering that they often inject political views into local news.

videos.title: Alex Jones
videos.overview: Alex Jones is known for pushing conspiracy theories, but he also spends a lot of time promoting his own products. John Oliver and a “doctor” “from” M.I.T. test out his marketing strategy.

videos.title: Border Patrol
videos.overview: Donald Trump's plan to hire more Border Patrol agents could lead to more corruption and misconduct. If only their recruitment ads were designed to attract the most suitable applicants.

videos.title: North Korea
videos.overview: As nuclear tensions continue to escalate between the United States and North Korea, John Oliver enlists "Weird Al" Yankovic to perform some accordion-based diplomacy.

videos.title: Nuclear Waste
videos.overview: Nuclear waste poses a serious threat to public health if it's not stored in a safe place. John Oliver explains why the United States desperately needs to build a metaphorical toilet for all that waste.

videos.title: Joe Arpaio
videos.overview: Donald Trump issued his first presidential pardon to the last person who should get one. John Oliver discusses the troubling record of former Arizona sheriff Joe Arpaio.

videos.title: Corporate Consolidation
videos.overview: Big businesses are getting even bigger thanks to a rise in corporate mergers. John Oliver explains why that could make you want to physically destroy your cable box.

videos.title: Forensic Science
videos.overview: Forensic science used in criminal trials can be surprisingly unscientific. Maybe a new television procedural could help change the public perception.

videos.title: Confederacy
videos.overview: Confederate symbols are still celebrated despite the ugly history they symbolize. John Oliver suggests some representations of southern pride that involve less racism and more Stephen Colbert.

videos.title: Equifax
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the massive impact of the cybersecurity breach at Equifax and their massively misguided attempts to mitigate the damage.

videos.title: Floods
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why our federal system for financing flood recovery perpetuates a pattern of destruction and why you should never offer a tortilla chip to a seagull.

videos.title: Economic Development
videos.overview: State and local governments offer large financial incentives to attract employers to their part of the country. John Oliver explains what communities get, or often don't get, in return.

videos.title: The Trump Presidency
videos.overview: One year after the presidential election, John Oliver discusses what we've learned so far and enlists our catheter cowboy to teach Donald Trump what he hasn't.

videos.title: Trump vs. The World
videos.overview: America's reputation is being damaged by its own president. John Oliver, several dinosaurs, and the NYC Gay Men's Chorus remind the world that our country is...complicated.

videos.title: Italian Election
videos.overview: Italy is in the throes of a turbulent race to elect a new prime minister. John Oliver discusses the colorful contenders and introduces an equally ridiculous candidate.

videos.title: NRA TV
videos.overview: The NRA's streaming lifestyle network aims to boost gun sales, often by using an ominous tone that would make just about anything sound terrifying...including muffins.

videos.title: Cryptocurrencies
videos.overview: Digital currencies are generating a lot of excitement. John Oliver enlists Keegan-Michael Key to get potential investors equally excited about the concept of caution.

videos.title: Mike Pence
videos.overview: John Oliver can't help but say nice things about the Vice President's rabbit, Marlon Bundo. Last Week Tonight even wrote a children's book about him.

videos.title: Immigration Courts
videos.overview: America’s dysfunctional immigration court system forces many children to appear in court alone. That’s as ridiculous in real life as it would be on a courtroom television show.

videos.title: Crisis Pregnancy Centers
videos.overview: Crisis pregnancy centers deceptively steer woman away from abortion. They can be started way too easily by religious groups like, for instance, a late night talk show’s megachurch.

videos.title: Corporate Taxes
videos.overview: Many of America’s largest corporations shift a surprising portion of their profits overseas to avoid paying taxes. Even more surprisingly, that’s a legal thing to do.

videos.title: Iran Deal
videos.overview: Donald Trump could soon dismantle the agreement designed to curb the Iranian nuclear program. Our catheter cowboy will do his best to keep that from happening.

videos.title: Rudy Giuliani
videos.overview: Rudy Giuliani is new to Trump’s legal team, but not to public controversy. Last Week Tonight examines his turbulent record in the wake of his recent political upsets.

videos.title: Venezuela
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the devastating economic crisis in Venezuela and enlists the help of a large bird who bears a striking resemblance to Wilmer Valderrama.

videos.title: Drug Rehabilitation Clinics
videos.overview: Other segments: Wedding of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle, proposed 2018 North Korea-United States summit

videos.title: Guardianship
videos.overview: It’s alarmingly easy for a total stranger to gain total control over the life of a senior citizen. We enlisted a group of celebrities to offer a warning about predatory behavior...in a legal guardian or a hippo.

videos.title: Stupid Watergate II
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how the president and his allies are going full O. J. in order to undermine the investigation of Russian interference in the 2016 election.

videos.title: Xi Jinping
videos.overview: Chinese president Xi Jinping is amassing an alarming amount of political power. If only his propaganda videos made the idea of unrestricted authority seem as troubling as the concept of singing children.

videos.title: Mexican Elections
videos.overview: Mexico is on the verge of a major election. John Oliver discusses some things we should know about the races and one thing we should not know about Santa Claus.

videos.title: Gene Editing
videos.overview: Scientists are developing new ways to alter the genetic code of living organisms. John Oliver explores the risks, rewards, and wolf-related hazards of gene editing.

videos.title: Workplace Sexual Harassment
videos.overview: With a national dialogue underway about sexual harassment in the workplace, John Oliver sits down with Anita Hill to discuss the recent response to a not-so-recent problem.

videos.title: Prosecutors
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how prosecutors use, or in some cases misuse, their power within our criminal justice system and why it’s important to know whether or not your district attorney is a dog.

videos.title: Astroturfing
videos.overview: Organizations can hire fake advocates who create the illusion of real support for their message. It’s a shady practice called astroturfing that can warp the public perception of anything...even astroturfing.

videos.title: Trade
videos.overview: Donald Trump is waging a trade war that hurts a lot of American workers. Maybe he would understand that if our heavy-handed documentaries about the global trading system were more informative.

videos.title: Felony Disenfranchisement
videos.overview: Many people with felony convictions are unfairly prohibited from voting, and the worst state for this — surprise — is Florida.

videos.title: Facebook
videos.overview: Facebook’s global expansion has been linked to political turmoil overseas, so maybe their ads should focus less on how they “connect the world” and more on why connecting people isn’t always the best idea.

videos.title: Brett Kavanaugh
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the ongoing controversy surrounding Brett Kavanaugh, the sexual assault allegations against him, his Supreme Court nomination, and what that could all mean for the highest (mostly-dog) court in the land.

videos.title: Brazilian Elections
videos.overview: Brazil is about to elect a new president during a turbulent period of political corruption and economic uncertainty. John Oliver urges the people of Brazil not to figuratively fingerbang their democracy.

videos.title: Saudi Arabia
videos.overview: Following the alarming disappearance of a Saudi journalist and political dissident, John Oliver examines America's uncomfortably comfortable relationship with Saudi Arabia.

videos.title: State Attorneys General
videos.overview: State AGs have become major partisan players in national politics, so the races to elect them are worth your attention.

videos.title: Family Separation
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the disturbing policy that separated migrant families detained at our southern border, and the disturbingly real chance that it could happen again.

videos.title: Drain the Swamp
videos.overview: Donald Trump promised to “drain the swamp.” But considering the culture of corruption inside of his administration, Washington is looking awfully...swampy.

videos.title: Authoritarianism
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the growing number of authoritarian leaders around the world, their common characteristics, and whether or not one of them is currently our president.

videos.title: Brexit III
videos.overview: The UK could officially leave the European Union next month, which would be a huge change with hugely damaging consequences.

videos.title: Psychics
videos.overview: Psychics may seem harmless and fun on TV, but they can make a lot of money by exploiting vulnerable people.

videos.title: Automation
videos.overview: Automation often seems like a scary new problem, but it’s neither entirely scary nor entirely new.

videos.title: Robocalls
videos.overview: Robocalls are a growing problem. If only we could make the FCC care a little bit more about fixing it.

videos.title: Public Shaming
videos.overview: John Oliver talks about the power of public shaming, good and bad.

videos.title: WWE
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses how the WWE takes care of its wrestlers — and how it doesn’t.

videos.title: Mobile Homes
videos.overview: Mobile homes may seem like an affordable housing option, but large investment companies are making them less and less so.

videos.title: Opioids II
videos.overview: Following some recent revelations about the role of large companies in America’s ongoing opioid epidemic, John Oliver takes another look at the crisis.

videos.title: Mueller Report
videos.overview: Following the release of the Mueller Report, John Oliver discusses what we’ve learned.

videos.title: Lethal Injections
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the lethal injection process, which is definitely not as pleasant as talking about a squeaking frog.

videos.title: Green New Deal
videos.overview: With the Green New Deal sparking a national conversation about all the ways to combat climate change, John Oliver looks at a few potential solutions.

videos.title: Death Investigations
videos.overview: America’s system for conducting death investigations is a mess. John Oliver explains why we should all be a little more concerned about fixing it.

videos.title: Medical Devices
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the medical device industry, which is a huge business with a hugely troubling lack of regulation.

videos.title: Equal Rights Amendment
videos.overview: There’s still nothing in our constitution that explicitly prohibits sex discrimination. John Oliver talks about how to fix that.

videos.title: Impeachment
videos.overview: With a national conversation underway about the possibility of impeachment, John Oliver discusses whether the benefits outweigh the potential risks.

videos.title: Everest
videos.overview: Climbing Mount Everest has become dangerously popular. John Oliver explains why.

videos.title: Warehouses
videos.overview: It’s easy to buy things online, and even easier not to think about how they get to you. John Oliver discusses what happens when you click “buy now.”

videos.title: Boris Johnson
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how Britain’s new prime minister, Boris Johnson, has succeeded – not despite his bumbling persona, but often because of it.

videos.title: Prison Labor
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how prisoners make and spend money, and how companies can profit at the expense of their families.

videos.title: Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedov
videos.overview: John Oliver takes a look at the president of Turkmenistan, a dangerous autocrat with some notably strange obsessions.

videos.title: Bias in Medicine
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the roles that gender and racial bias can play in medical treatment.

videos.title: Filibuster
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why filibusters exist, why they shouldn't, and why it's stupid to drink coffee like a cat.

videos.title: Legal Immigration
videos.overview: Legal immigration is a term which was repeated throughout the Trump presidency. But John Oliver explains its absurdity as well as why people resort to illegal means to enter the country. He breaks down all the four ways a person can enter USA legally: Family, Employment, Good Luck (Visa Lottery), Bad Luck (Refugee).

videos.title: Compounding Pharmacies
videos.overview: Compounding pharmacies create medication tailored to the specific needs of individual patients. John Oliver explains why this small corner of the drug market can cause big problems.

videos.title: One Child Policy
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses China’s one-child policy, and all its consequences, intended and not.

videos.title: Weather
videos.overview: John talks about Weather forecasting, Barry Lee Myers and the National Weather Service

videos.title: Trump & Syria
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the alarming decision to pull U.S. troops away from the border between Turkey and Syria.

videos.title: Voting Machines
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses how voting machines work, how they don’t, and how we can fix them.

videos.title: SLAPP Suits
videos.overview: After winning a legal battle involving a coal executive and a giant squirrel, John Oliver explains how SLAPP suits are designed to stifle public dissent.

videos.title: The Census
videos.overview: Main story: 2020 United States Census; plus, the impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump and Chiitan.

videos.title: Medicare for All
videos.overview: Main story: The pros and cons of Medicare for All; plus, Bill Barr does Trump's personal bidding; and Flyers mascot Gritty is exonerated!

videos.title: Modi
videos.overview: Main story: John Oliver talks about India's controversial Prime Minister, Narendra Modi, and his government's Hindu nationalism; plus, a look at Mike Bloomberg's presidential campaign.

videos.title: Coronavirus
videos.overview: John covers the Covid-19 pandemic, how each country, including the US, is handling it, and why the Phillie Phanatic is in a copyright row. Also, Tom Steyer quits the Democratic presidential race, and Chris Matthews messes up his sign offs.

videos.title: Sheriffs
videos.overview: Main story: A look at how much power and how little accountability local sheriffs have; plus, Trump's coronavirus incompetence; India's self-censorship of 'Last Week Tonight.'

videos.title: Coronavirus II
videos.overview: Main story: 2019–20 coronavirus outbreak, governmental response in the US, and the prevention of COVID-19. This episode was filmed at an unspecified location with no live audience as the studio and the show's offices were shut down after employees tested positive for COVID-19. John Oliver stated the show will go on hiatus for an unspecified amount of time but will definitely return.

videos.title: Coronavirus III
videos.overview: In the first show from his makeshift home studio, John covers the horrible way COVID-19 pandemic is going and how Trump is mishandling it, how TV hosts are practicing social distancing, and how profoundly gleeful 90s erotic rat art can be.

videos.title: One America News Network
videos.overview: John criticizes the Republican governors' response to the pandemic, showcases how everyone filming from home gets asked if they're wearing pants, and warns of the new ultra right wing, extremely pro-Trump network called OAN(N).

videos.title: Essential Workers
videos.overview: John explains how the Trump administration failed to protect the unemployed, small businesses and essential workers during the pandemic, the peeps make their unholy return, and 90s rat erotica makes John's day once again.

videos.title: Coronavirus Misinformation
videos.overview: John analyzes the right wing media's protests, conspiracy theories and misinformation spreading about the pandemic, spotlights Inside Edition's latest 'coming up' segments, and becomes a fan of the home edition of The Wendy Williams Show.

videos.title: COVID-19 Testing
videos.overview: John points out the failure of The FDA and federal government when experts encourage widespread coronavirus testing for several months. The number of tests being done everyday far behind the lowest recommended number. John talks about the different types of tests: diagnostic and antibody tests, and how the tests work.

videos.title: United States Postal Service
videos.overview: John discusses the United States Postal Service which is in dire need of economic assistance from the government. He examines some of the essential services of the USPS and why it is facing such financial trouble due to a 2006 law requiring it to pre-pay health care benefits on a fifty year schedule while at the same time putting price caps on services and products.

videos.title: Coronavirus Impact on Sports
videos.overview: John discusses the sudden disappearance of sports due to coronavirus, how their absence is impacting people emotionally and financially, and the complications of bringing them back anytime soon.

videos.title: Postal Voting
videos.overview: John explains the importance of voting by mail. Also, mass protests against police brutality erupt in Minneapolis, TV hosts inquire about the odd objects behind their stay-at-home guests, and John schools UFC president Dana White.

videos.title: Police
videos.overview: This episode tackles the hard truth about the history of Police in the United States and the many problems that are faced in fixing those problems.

videos.title: Facial Recognition
videos.overview: Facial recognition is no longer an issue of a thriller movie. It has become a part of our life. John Oliver talks about various aspects and global practice of facial recognition technology. He explains how dangerous it could be by addressing the questionable activities of facial recognition company Clearview AI.

videos.title: Prisons & Jails
videos.overview: In the latest episode on coronavirus John talks about US prisons and jails. These confined spaces have frightening number of COVID-19 infections. And there has been insufficient initiatives to address the matter. Consequently, in some cases inmates are taking matters in their own hand to raise concern about situation behind bars.

videos.title: Coronavirus IX: Evictions
videos.overview: Like coronavirus and unemployment issues evictions is something that USA could prepared for. While people are choosing between rent and food due to the pandemic, John Oliver presented the flaws of current system and flawed solution. He urges federal government to come with a proper solution for the affected soon. Also, some people refuse to wear masks, and Papa John embraces TikTok.

videos.title: Conspiracy Theories
videos.overview: Conspiracy theories are the hotcakes of the internet. John talks about why people like these conspiracy theories and why in the age of internet it spreads so quickly. He also explains the detrimental effect can have on people's life. Finally celebrities urges people to be more vigilant and inquisitive about these theories as majority of these theories are baseless and created to create unrest among people.

videos.title: Uighurs
videos.overview: The Uighur people are facing human rights abuses in China; plus, Trump’s authoritarian show of force in Portland; Martha Stewart loosens up.

videos.title: U.S. History
videos.overview: A look at how the history of race is taught in schools; plus, Trump pushes bad medicine; Louie Gohmert tests positive; and Steve Guttenberg has a 'Cameo.'

videos.title: Juries
videos.overview: John Oliver takes a look at why people of color are routinely excluded from becoming jurors, who their absence impacts, and what we can do to create a fairer system.

videos.title: Border Wall
videos.overview: Nearing the 2020 election, John Oliver checks in on one of the key promises of President Trump’s 2016 campaign: the border wall. Plus, The “Unconventional Convention”; the return of Pumpkin Spice.

videos.title: RNC 2020 & Kenosha
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses a week that saw the Republican National Convention, a horrific series of shootings in Kenosha, Wisconsin, and a strike in professional sports -- three stories that are really one story, about race in America.

videos.title: Supreme Court
videos.overview: In the wake of Ruth Bader Ginsburg’s death, John Oliver discusses the future of the Supreme Court, why the government doesn’t always represent the political leanings of the electorate, and how those issues will impact the next generation of Americans.

videos.title: Election 2020
videos.overview: Weeks out from the 2020 presidential election, John Oliver takes a look at various efforts to destabilize the vote, how to ensure your ballot is properly counted, and why we may need to prepare not just for an election night, but for an election month.

videos.title: The World Health Organization
videos.overview: John Oliver talks about the functions of World Health Organization and why it is a vital part of the upcoming US election. John points out the contribution WHO made over the years, explains the reason why USA pays more than other countries and describes the mistakes of this highly impactful organization.

videos.title: Asylum
videos.overview: John Oliver talks about the situation of asylum seekers in USA under Trump administration. He points out the three major changes in policy (migrant protection protocols, safe third country agreements and Title 42) which are deciding the future of asylum seekers.

videos.title: Trump & the Coronavirus and William Barr
videos.overview: John Oliver takes a look at how the Trump administration has handled the coronavirus outbreak in the US, from lack of preparation, to mangled coordination, to harmful communication. John also discusses William Barr’s attitude toward authority and executive power, how that attitude has influenced Donald Trump’s presidency, and what it could mean if Trump wins a second term.

videos.title: Election Results 2020
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the long week of US presidential election results, including Donald Trump’s various attempts to make the election appear illegitimate, and a historic win for Joe Biden and Kamala Harris.

videos.title: Trump & Election Results
videos.overview: A week after Joe Biden’s win in the US presidential election, John Oliver discusses Donald Trump’s various attempts to overturn the results, why his claims don’t hold water, and the consequences of indulging him.

videos.title: Episode 210: The Next Pandemic
videos.overview: Main story: What could cause the next pandemic, what we can do to avoid it, and why you shouldn’t kiss pigs; plus, Impeachment Part 2.

videos.title: Episode 211: Meatpacking
videos.overview: Main story: Working conditions in the meatpacking industry; plus, the Texas power crisis in the wake of severe winter weather.

videos.title: Episode 212: Raids
videos.overview: Main story: How few guardrails there are on the use of police raids; plus, New York governor Andrew Cuomo faces multiple scandals.

videos.title: Episode 213: Unemployment
videos.overview: Main story: The many obstacles that impede access to unemployment benefits; plus, Fox News freaks out over Dr. Seuss.

videos.title: Episode 214: Tucker Carlson
videos.overview: Main story: Where Tucker Carlson came from and why he's admired by white nationalists; plus, reaction to the Biden COVID-19 relief bill.

videos.title: Episode 215: Plastics
videos.overview: Main story: How plastics are harming the planet, and why recycling isn’t the solution you think it is; plus, the Atlanta mass shootings and hate crimes against Asian-Americans.

videos.title: Episode 216: The National Debt
videos.overview: Main story: How national debt works and why it might be more helpful than you'd think; plus, Giuliani freaks over Lil Nas X; Amazon's anti-union tactics; Peeps and Pepsi form an unholy alliance.

videos.title: Episode 217: Long-Term Care
videos.overview: Main story: Why nursing homes and assisted living facilities need fixing; plus, the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program; Matt Gaetz and Venmo; R.I.P. Yahoo! Answers.

videos.title: Episode 218: Bankruptcy
videos.overview: John Oliver details why people file for bankruptcy, how needlessly difficult the process can be, and the ways we can better serve people struggling with debt.

videos.title: Episode 219: Vaccine
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why some people don't want to get the Covid-19 vaccine and how they might be reassured.

videos.title: Episode 220: Hair
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the importance of black hair, the ways it can be a target of discrimination, and some ideas to address that.

videos.title: Episode 221: Stand Your Ground
videos.overview: Main Story: John Oliver takes a look at why “stand your ground” laws were created, who they protect, and, crucially, who they don’t. Plus, a look at the past week’s events in Israel.

videos.title: Episode 222: Sponcon
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why the integrity of local news is so important, how sponsored content could damage that integrity, and why the Venus Veil is so much more than a blanket. (It's not.)

videos.title: Episode 223: Asian Americans
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the large and diverse group of people who fall under the term "Asian American", the history of the model minority stereotype, and why our conversations on the subject need to be better-informed.

videos.title: Episode 224: Prison Heat
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how the failure to air-condition prisons can cause both physical and mental health issues for incarcerated people, and why the solution is simpler than you might think. Plus, some truly unique local car dealership ads.

videos.title: Episode 225: PACE
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how PACE, a program meant to pay for environmentally-friendly home renovations, is fundamentally flawed and can put people at risk of losing their homes. Plus, why hosting summer Olympics in Tokyo this year is a bad idea and why dog shows are weird.

videos.title: Episode 226: Health Care Sharing Ministries
videos.overview: Health Care Sharing Ministries, or HCSMs, advertise themselves as a more affordable, faith-based alternative to health insurance. But John Oliver explains some of the massive limitations these plans can have.

videos.title: Episode 227: Housing Discrimination
videos.overview: John Oliver breaks down the long history of housing discrimination in the U.S., the damage it's done, and, crucially, what we can do about it.

videos.title: Episode 228: Emergency Medical Services
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how emergency medical services function in the U.S., why they can be so expensive, and what we can do to fix things.

videos.title: Episode 229: Opioids III – The Sacklers
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how the Sackler family has been handling lawsuits related to the opioid crisis, how hard they've been fighting to defend their name, and why you should judge the situation for yourself.

videos.title: Episode 230: Ransomware
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses ransomware attacks, why they’re on the rise, and what can be done about them.

videos.title: August 22, 2021: Afghanistan
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the end of America's war with Afghanistan and the humanitarian crisis being left behind.

videos.title: September 12, 2021: Lukashenko
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the longtime leader of Belarus, Alexander Lukashenko, and the many reasons his country's citizens have not to like him.

videos.title: September 26, 2021: Voting Rights
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the current attacks on voting rights, who's behind them, and what we can do about it. Plus, John enters several paintings in the annual Duck Stamp contest.

videos.title: October 3, 2021: PFAS
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses PFAS - a class of chemicals linked to an array of health issues - and why their widespread use isn't as magical as it may seem.

videos.title: Episode 235
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses how misinformation spreads among immigrant diaspora communities, how little some platforms have done to stop it, and, most importantly, how to have a very good morning.

videos.title: Episode 236
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses Taiwan's history of being governed by other countries, its fraught present-day relationship with China, and what its citizens would want their future to look like.

videos.title: Episode 237
videos.overview: With homelessness increasing nationwide, John Oliver takes a look at the way we discuss the unhoused, what policy failures are making the problem worse, and how we can help.

videos.title: Episode 238
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the current state of the nation's power grid, why it needs fixing, and, of course, how fun the balloons are.

videos.title: Episode 239
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses the mechanics of union busting, why the companies who do it face so few consequences, and what it really means when your manager wants to talk to you about "your attendance."

videos.title: February 20, 2022: Critical Race Theory
videos.overview: John Oliver explains what critical race theory is, what it isn't, and why we can expect to hear more about it in the coming months. Plus, the Canadian trucker protests.

videos.title: February 27, 2022: Sex Work
videos.overview: As long as sex work has existed, so have efforts to end it. John Oliver explains why criminalizing the trade hasn’t helped the most vulnerable people involved, and why we should start listening to those at the center of the conversation: sex workers. Plus, Russian invasion into Ukraine, that has placed the whole world at the brink of WW3.

videos.title: March 6, 2022: Wrongful Convictions
videos.overview: John Oliver talks about the current practices of overturning wrongful convictions and how it is quite unsupportive of even apparently innocent people. He advocates for urgent reforms in the flawed system which is clearly not working in favor of the innocents. Plus, the heroic resistance of Ukrainians against the invasion of Russia.

videos.title: March 13, 2022: Tickets
videos.overview: John Oliver explains why concert tickets are so expensive, who’s making money off of them, and which One Direction is his favorite. Plus, the introduction of some appalling anti-LGBT laws in several states.

videos.title: March 27, 2022: Harm Reduction
videos.overview: John Oliver discusses why overdoses in the U.S. have been on the rise and what we should, and shouldn't, be doing to prevent them. Plus, a rather odd yearly tradition in Nenana, Alaska.

videos.title: April 3, 2022: Trucks
videos.overview: John Oliver explains how truck drivers get paid, how they often don’t, and how companies exploit them to increase profits. Plus, Republican congressman Madison Cawthorn's tales of GOP orgies and drug use has him in trouble with his own party.
